events.event: KPK names Klaten Bupati Hamenang Wajar Ismoyo, Central Java BPK head Ahmad Luthfi Rahmatullah and private party M. Amin Wahyu Utomo suspects after a 15 Oct sting (OTT) and detains them for 20 days on 16 Oct; KPK alleges five clusters of bribery and gratification including payment to remove an audit finding.
events.key_numbers: OTT 15 Oct in Klaten and Jakarta · 20 other people secured · Rp1.9 miliar cash seized · alleged Rp400 juta to BPK head to drop a Rp5 miliar honorarium-overpayment finding in FY2025 audit · >Rp2 miliar procurement fees · Rp245 juta galian C permits · >=Rp1.8 miliar from regional enterprises since 2025 · >=Rp280 juta from BPKPAD staff · 3 detained 20 days (16 Oct)
events.why_it_matters: A regional head and the state auditor's own provincial chief caught together shows how audit results can allegedly be bought, which affects how much people can trust local government accounts.

events.event: KPK names five suspects (one woman, four men) and detains them after the 13 Oct sting at BNPB; BNPB Sestama Rustian was questioned but remains a witness and was allowed to leave.
events.key_numbers: 14 people caught in OTT on 13 Oct · 5 named suspects and detained (14 Oct) · Rustian status: witness · identities and roles of the five not disclosed at time of reporting
events.why_it_matters: The case concerns emergency disaster funds, money meant for victims, and the agency head was replaced two days later.

events.event: DPR plenary makes the Asset Forfeiture Bill (RUU Perampasan Aset) a DPR initiative bill; Komisi III says it will pass by 15 Dec 2026 at the latest, with DIM discussion with the government starting 10 Nov after recess.
events.key_numbers: 326 of 576 members attended · 8 factions gave written positions · 62 public hearings (RDPU) + 8 working visits since Sep 2025 · recess 9 Oct–9 Nov · DIM talks from 10 Nov · target passage 15 Dec 2026
events.why_it_matters: The law would let the state seize assets from corruption and other crimes without waiting for a criminal conviction; Habiburokhman said it must not be used against political opponents.

events.event: DPR Komisi III and the government are scheduled to begin the DIM (issues list) discussion on the Asset Forfeiture Bill at the start of the next session after recess.
events.key_numbers: DPR recess 9 Oct–9 Nov · DIM start 10 Nov · target passage by 15 Dec 2026
events.why_it_matters: This is the next checkpoint for whether the bill really passes within about five weeks.

events.event: Prabowo chairs a limited cabinet meeting at Istana Bogor ahead of the government's second anniversary on 20 Oct; ministers gave few details, saying it was about togetherness and monitoring Asta Cita programmes.
events.key_numbers: about 2 hours (c. 19:00–22:00 WIB) · anniversary 20 Oct 2026 · Housing Minister Maruarar Sirait invited the President to a 2.4 juta roof-tile event in Majalengka (8 Nov) and a 71,000-house event in Malang (17 Dec)
events.why_it_matters: It sets the scene for the two-year evaluation on 20 Oct, a day after the stock market fell below 5,000 and a day after the eighth reshuffle.

events.event: KSPI and Partai Buruh announce staggered rallies from 15 to 30 Oct in 38 provinces demanding a 7.5%-9.5% minimum wage rise for 2027 and provincial minimum wages (UMP/UMSP) set by 1 Nov 2026.
events.key_numbers: 7.5%–9.5% UMP 2027 demand · rallies 15–30 Oct in 38 provinces · tens of thousands expected · UMP/UMSP by 1 Nov 2026 · severance demand: at least 1x statutory, not 0.5x · outsourcing limited to 4 job types (cleaning, security, drivers, catering)
events.why_it_matters: It decides how much monthly pay rises for millions of workers in 2027, at a time when inflation is 3.28% and layoffs are being reported.

events.event: Unions' deadline for provinces to set 2027 UMP and UMSP (1 Nov); government has not yet published a formula or figure in the sources found.
events.key_numbers: deadline 1 Nov 2026 · union demand 7.5%–9.5% · BI-Rate and inflation context: inflation 3.28% y/y (Sep)
events.why_it_matters: Wage announcements normally follow in November, and the Labour Minister's stance will show whether the demand is met.

events.event: KPK names five suspects in the BNPB emergency-fund (DSP) sting case, including BNPB expert staff Bima Setiawan (younger brother of former BNPB head Suharyanto), and says it will look for other parties and trace the money flow; ICW urges the probe to reach higher officials.
events.key_numbers: 5 suspects: Bima Setiawan, Richard Erlangga, Gabriel Purwaka Sigit (PPK), Syifa Nrika Ghifarin, Gery Prasetiawan · first 20-day detention 14 Oct–2 Nov · KPK coordinating with Puspom TNI on alleged involvement of active TNI members · DSP funds meant for karhutla (Kalimantan, Papua), NTT earthquake, Aceh/Sumatra floods · no sums stated · allegations, not proven in court
events.why_it_matters: The money was meant for disaster victims, and KPK has not ruled out higher-ups or military personnel.

events.event: Former members of DPR Komisi II (2019-2024), led by Golkar's Ahmad Doli Kurnia, say Article 18(3) of KPU Regulation (PKPU) 19/2023, nicknamed 'pasal Gibran banget' by petitioners in the MK diploma case, was never discussed in their consultation meetings with the KPU; Doli says the committee cannot investigate how it got in, and that the content is KPU's responsibility.
events.key_numbers: Group met in Jakarta on 18 Oct · consultation letters from KPU dated 15 and 19 Sep (2023) · consultation meeting 20 Sep (2023) · covered 4 PKPU · MK case 01/PHPU.PRES-XXIV/2026
events.why_it_matters: It reopens the question of how a rule on candidate requirements ended up in a KPU regulation, a month after the MK ruled the petition inadmissible.

events.event: Prabowo receives UN Secretary-General Antonio Guterres at his Hambalang residence; the Cabinet Secretariat says Guterres praised Indonesia's foreign policy and aid to Palestinians and said farewell ahead of the end of his term in December 2026; Guterres also to honour Indonesian peacekeepers and speak at the Foreign Ministry.
events.key_numbers: 50 Indonesian peacekeepers died in UN service · Guterres's term ends Dec 2026 · Indonesian troops about to deploy to MINUSCA (Central African Republic) · visit to TNI peacekeeping training centre (PMPP) Bogor · speech at Foreign Ministry
events.why_it_matters: A visit by the UN chief on the eve of the government's second anniversary gives the President a diplomatic showcase.

events.event: Two pollsters release two-year satisfaction surveys on Prabowo: Parameter Politik Indonesia finds 65.2% satisfied and Adidaya Institute 60.3% (VP Gibran 51.4%), contrasting with the SMRC figure of 51.1% cited by critics.
events.key_numbers: PPI: 65.2% satisfied (62.3% puas + 2.9% sangat puas), n=1,200, MoE ±2.83%, fieldwork 26 Sep–6 Oct · Adidaya: Prabowo 60.3% satisfied / 36.2% dissatisfied; Gibran 51.4% / 44.8%; government overall 52.8% / 30.4%, n=1,240, MoE ±2.78%, fieldwork 15–21 Sep · PPI also: 62.2% agree with reshuffles, 67% trust in government (headlines)
events.why_it_matters: Different pollsters give very different pictures of public satisfaction, which makes a good 'how to read a survey' explainer for the anniversary.

events.event: Bakom cites BPS data for the two-year mark: poverty rate 8.07% in March 2026, 22.93 million poor people, 920,000 fewer than March 2025.
events.key_numbers: 8.07% (Mar 2026) · 22.93 juta people · -920,000 vs Mar 2025 · 2021-2025: 10.14% → 8.47% · extreme poverty 2.14% → 0.85% · Gini 0.384 → 0.375 · government claim via Bakom, no independent assessment in source
events.why_it_matters: Clear official numbers on poverty for the anniversary; worth setting beside critics' claims.

events.event: DPR Komisi II's working committee (Panja) on the Election Bill (RUU Pemilu), formed 29 Sep, is discussing ten strategic issues including whether the parliamentary threshold rises from 4% to 5% and whether regional heads stay directly elected or go to DPRD; no decision yet.
events.key_numbers: threshold 4% → 5% (proposed, under discussion) · 10 strategic issues, 5 priorities (national/regional election split, threshold, direct vs DPRD election of regional heads, seat numbers, KPU/Bawaslu size) · Panja formed 29 Sep, chair Bahtra Banong named 8 Oct
events.why_it_matters: The rules decide how ordinary people vote for president, DPR and governors in the next election.

events.event: Makassar Mayor Munafri Arifuddin, who resigned from Golkar on 5 Oct, returns his candidacy form to run for chair of Partai Demokrat in South Sulawesi; the regional conference (Musda) is scheduled for 23 Oct in Makassar.
events.key_numbers: resigned Golkar 5 Oct · candidacy form returned 18 Oct · Musda 23 Oct · claims backing from 24 Demokrat district/city branches (unverified)
events.why_it_matters: A sitting mayor moving parties shows how regional politicians reposition around the national coalition.

events.event: A school headmaster in Glagah, Lamongan is allegedly punched by a student's parent reported to be a TNI member after a dispute over a student's missing socks; the victim, backed by LBH PCNU Lamongan, reported it to Subdenpom TNI Lamongan.
events.key_numbers: incident 17 Oct · reported same evening · reported injuries: facial bruising near the eye, fractured nose · official forensic report (visum) pending · no TNI statement found · perpetrator's TNI membership as reported, not confirmed
events.why_it_matters: A teacher allegedly assaulted by a soldier raises the question of how military-linked cases are handled, in military rather than civilian courts.

events.event: Polda Metro Jaya examines a police officer suspected of fatally shooting a fellow officer at the Polairud base in Pondok Cabe, South Tangerang; the victim's family lawyer calls it premeditated and says more than one person may be involved.
events.key_numbers: shooting c. 05:30 WIB 16 Oct · handled by Subdit Jatanras Ditreskrimum Polda Metro Jaya · family lawyer: bayonet and firearm seized, may not involve only one person (allegation) · ranks reported inconsistently
events.why_it_matters: A death inside the police force, days after a new Kapolri took office, puts internal discipline in the spotlight.

gaps: Nothing fresh found for the last 48 hours (17-19 Oct) on KPK, Kejagung, MK, MA, Komnas HAM, KPU/Bawaslu or party moves: search results were mostly older articles; worth a second look on Detik/Kompas politics and hukum front pages.
KPK BNPB case: identities, roles and amounts for the 5 suspects not found; also not confirmed whether the Rustian-witness status changed.
